meta_description: Mike Tree Interior Decorators in Leeds. Expert interior painting and decorating. Free quotes, attention to detail, competitive rates. Call 07833 672818.
hero_subhead: Transform your Leeds home with expert interior painting and decorating that lasts. Free quotes, no fuss.
services_heading: Complete Interior Decorating Services Across Leeds
services_subhead: From feature walls to full home redecorating, we handle every interior project with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Painting
services.desc: Professional interior wall and ceiling painting using quality paints and techniques that ensure a flawless finish. We protect your furniture and floors, leaving your home clean and ready to enjoy.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging
services.desc: Expert wallpaper selection and installation for feature walls or entire rooms. We match patterns perfectly and remove old wallpaper cleanly, leaving crisp, professional results.

services.title: Feature Walls & Accent Colours
services.desc: Create impact with bold colour choices or textured finishes. We advise on colour schemes that complement your space and execute them to a high standard.

services.title: Woodwork & Trim
services.desc: Skilled painting of skirting boards, architraves, doors, and window frames. We prepare surfaces properly and apply finishes that resist chipping and wear.

services.title: Staircase Decoration
services.desc: Full staircase makeovers including walls, risers, railings, and handrails. We work efficiently to minimise disruption while keeping your home safe and usable.

services.title: Plaster & Wall Prep
services.desc: Professional surface preparation including filling, sanding, and priming. Poor prep ruins a finish — we get it right from the start, ensuring paint goes on smooth and even.

about_pullquote: I finish every job like it's my own home — that's the Mike Tree standard.
about_para_1: Mike Tree Interior Decorators has been transforming homes across Leeds for 18 years. What started as a one-man operation built on quality and reliability has grown into a trusted local name. Mike and the team pride themselves on attention to detail, preparation, and using quality materials that last.
about_para_2: Our repeat customer rate tells the story — most of our work comes from recommendations and previous clients calling us back. We listen carefully to what you want, give honest advice about what works, and deliver results that exceed expectations. Fair pricing, professional conduct, and a clean site when we leave are non-negotiable for us.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About Mike Tree

reviews.text: Mike came round to give a quote for our lounge and dining room, and was brilliant — really helpful with colour choices and honest about what would work best. The job itself was immaculate. He and his mate worked efficiently, kept everything tidy, and the finish is just perfect. Couldn't ask for more. Will be calling him back for the hallway.
reviews.author: Rachel P.

reviews.text: Had our staircase and landing done. The prep work was thorough — he filled every gap and sanded everything smooth. The paint went on beautifully and it's held up really well. Competitively priced too. Definitely recommend.
reviews.author: David H.

reviews.text: Three rooms redecorated. Arrived on time, worked systematically, and left the place spotless each day. The attention to detail with the woodwork and corners is what sets him apart. Five stars.
reviews.author: Susan K.
